name: cloudflare-tunnel
description: A remotely-managed Cloudflare tunnel, its ingress rules, the DNS records pointing at it, and the token `cloudflared` dials out with
instructions: Reads the Cloudflare API through `../cloudflare-api`; needs a token with Tunnel and DNS write. It refuses to adopt a locally-managed tunnel, because that kind ignores the configuration API while returning success — the resulting drift is invisible from the dashboard and from an apply alike. The connector token is an output; write it to disk with a file-converging module rather than pasting it into a unit.
